research_scope: Current-version mechanics reconciliation for the core CaC Awoken roster. Only values supported by current or independently corroborated sources are promoted; conflicting values remain explicitly qualified.

mechanics.resource_note: faster Stamina regeneration; the in-game Ki-recovery wording is treated as a translation error

corrections.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
corrections.notes: The form requires 500 Ki but current references describe the value as a requirement rather than a permanent Ki expenditure; sustained Ki drain is represented through reduced Ki recovery/current drain documentation.

corrections.name: Kaioken

mechanics.stamina_drain: 3.5 per second in maintained technical corpus; current wiki expresses drain as 6% rate

corrections.notes: Drain-rate units differ between technical research and wiki presentation; retain both rather than treating them as directly interchangeable.

mechanics.stamina_drain: 7.5 per second in maintained technical corpus; current wiki expresses 12% rate
33 per second in maintained technical corpus; current wiki expresses 46% rate

corrections.name: Potential Unleashed
corrections.notes: The current Awoken table and dedicated page agree on the 500-Ki requirement and +15% all-attack/+5% defense model. Whether the 500 Ki is actually consumed versus merely required is inconsistently represented by sources and remains a version/data-field reconciliation item.

corrections.name: Beast
corrections.notes: Dedicated current reference explicitly states that Beast consumes 500 Ki on activation.

corrections.name: Ultra Instinct
corrections.notes: Update 1.22 behavior is retained: the skill requires 500 Ki but no longer consumes five Ki bars during transformation. It also restores ordinary quick Ki blasts while retaining Soaring Fist/Spirit Pulse for charged inputs.

mechanics.stamina_drain: 20 per second in maintained technical corpus

corrections.name: The Power to Overcome

stage_2.all_attack: +30% for Strike/Ki supers and Ultimates; Basic Attack +15% in maintained technical guide
stage_2.health_drain: approximately half a health bar over 12 seconds

corrections.notes: New 2026 independent testing materially narrows the uncertainty: Stage 2 is a roughly 12-second burst with extremely rapid/infinite effective Ki regeneration and health drain. Stage-1 defense is reported as +20% by the maintained technical guide, while community testing has reported lower values. Cooldown is still not promoted as an exact canonical number because sources report about 24 versus 30 seconds.
